title: Spirits Bottle Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spirit:bottle
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by spirit_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when spirits bottle data has stopped arriving for a given spirit type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per spirit type and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your spirits bottle feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
